description: Installation of low-carbon energy infrastructure and associated decarbonisation works across the Hammersmith Hospital campus, including the erection of packaged plantrooms and substations; installation of heat pumps and associated acoustic enclosures; construction of roof-level plant decks, access structures and service bridges; installation, replacement and upgrading of rooftop plant, roof insulation and associated mechanical and electrical equipment; associated structural works, service connections, cable routes and all other ancillary works.
subdivision_of_building:
Mortuary Building (Building 122) – Extension to the existing roof-level plantroom to accommodate water source heat pumps, buffer vessels, pumps, associated electrical equipment and ancillary infrastructure.
D Block (Building 107) Roof – Replacement of existing rooftop plant with a water source heat pump within an acoustic and weatherproof enclosure.
D Block (Building 107) Ground Floor – Installation of a new external packaged plantroom above the existing basement plantroom, including associated structural alterations, ventilation works and service infrastructure.
QCCH (Building 101) Roof – Installation of a new packaged plantroom, water source heat pump within a GRP acoustic enclosure, buffer vessel and associated plant and services.
QCCH Energy Centre (Building 101) – Construction of a raised roof-level plant deck, associated structural steelwork and external staircase, together with associated electrical infrastructure and building integration works.
Plant Area (North of Site) – Installation of a new abstraction plant comprising a two-storey packaged plantroom on a raised steel platform with associated access stairs, pipework and ancillary infrastructure.
Hammersmith House (Building 305) Roof – Installation of ground source heat pumps on raised structural platforms, together with service gantries, pipe bridges linking to the Renal Building (Building 555), associated pipework, roof insulation and ancillary infrastructure.
Hammersmith House (Building 305) Ground Floor Plantroom – Installation of a new external packaged plantroom adjacent to the existing basement plantroom, including associated mechanical and electrical equipment.
Hammersmith House (Building 305) Ground Floor Substation (DSS13) – Installation of a new packaged electrical substation comprising RMUs, transformers, low voltage switchboards and associated infrastructure.
Renal Building (Building 555) Roof – Retention of an existing water source heat pump and associated infrastructure installed under the wider decarbonisation programme (retrospective element).
Renal Building (Building 555) Electrical Infrastructure (DSS7) – Replacement of existing high-voltage switchgear and transformers with new RMUs and close-coupled transformers.
A Block Roof – Installation of a new packaged electrical substation (DSS15) comprising an RMU, transformer, low voltage switchboard and associated infrastructure within a GRP enclosure.
